violations.description: Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. Tested sanitizer bottle at 0ppm Quat at time of inspection.

General equipment and utensils - Materials and design. — --Material of nonfood contact surface was not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable. Observed storage for the post mix fountain syrup shelving needs to be sealed.
General employee cleanliness. — --Food employee did not wash hands as necessary. -Observed employee putting on gloves without washing hands at hand sink.
Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not stored in a clean, dry location a minimum of 6 inches above the floor. -Observed box of food on floor of walk in freezer.
Cleaning frequency, maintained clean (2 pts deducted)
Cleaning frequency, maintained clean (1 pt deducted)
